info.title: Half-Life: Wii U Edition
info.author: NanoBunTV
info.description: A native port of the original Half-Life
info.details:
A native port of Half-Life to the Wii U, for the Aroma homebrew environment.

Also includes optional support for Blue Shift and Opposing Force.

Playable on a real Wii U. Most of the game runs at 60 FPS; big fights with many enemies can drop into the 50s.

For full features list and controls, check out the GitHub: github.com/NanoBunTV/Wii-U-Half-Life

Installing: Copy the `valve` folder from your Steam install (`Steam\steamapps\common\Half-Life\valve`, about 600 MB) to `sd:/wiiu/apps/halflife/`. Start Half-Life from the Wii U Menu. If the game files aren't found, it says so on screen.

Disclosure: AI was used to assist in development.
